condition.name: Bane
condition.description: Subtract 1D4 from attack roll or save

condition.name: Bless
condition.description: Add 1D4 to an attack roll or save

condition.name: Blinded
condition.description:
While you have the Blinded condition you experience the following effects:
Cant See: You cant see and automatically fail any ability checks that recquire site.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have advantage and your attack roles have disadvantage

condition.name: Booming Blade
condition.description:
If you move more than 5 feet, you take 1D8 Thunder damage.
At 5th level: this is increased to 2D8
At 11th level: this is increased to 3D8
At 17th level: this is increased to 4D8

condition.name: Burning
condition.description: A burning creature or object takes 1D4 fire damage at the start of each turn. As an action, you can extinguish fire on yourself by giving yourself the Prone condition and rolling on the ground. The fire also goes out if it is doused, submerged, or suffocated.

condition.name: Charmed
condition.description:
While you have the charmed condition, you experience the following effects:
Cant't Harm the Charmer: You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects
Social Advantage: The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.

condition.name: Deafened
condition.description:
While you have the Deafened condition, you experience the following effect:
Can't Hear: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability that recquires hearing

condition.name: Exhaustion
condition.description:
While you have the Exhaustion condition, you experence the following effects:
Exaustion Levels: This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Exhaustion level. You die if your Exhaustion level is 6
D20 Tests Affected: Whaen you make a D20 test, the role is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level.
Speed Reduced: Your speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level
Removing Eshaustion Levels: Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 of your Exhaustion Levels. When your Exaustion level reaches 0 the condition is removed

condition.name: Frightened
condition.description:
While you have the Frightened condition, you experience the following effects:
Ability Checks and Attack Effected: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of the fear is within line of site
Can't Approach: You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear

condition.name: Grappled
condition.description:
While you have the grappled condition, you experience the following effects:
Speed 0: Your speed is 0 and cannot increase
Attacks Affected: You have Disadvantge on attack roles against any target other than the grappler
Movable: The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but every foot of movement costs it 1 extra foot unless you are tiny or two or more sizes smaller than it

condition.name: Guidence
condition.description: Choose a skill. Add 1D4 to any ability check using that skill.

condition.name: Incapacitated
condition.description:
While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experence the following effects:
Inactive: You can't take an action, bounus action or reaction
No Concentration: Your Concentration is brocken
Speechless: You Cannot Speek
Surprised: If you are Incapacitated when you roll initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll

condition.name: Invisible
condition.description:
When you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects:
Surprise: If your Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll
Concealed: You aren't affected by any effect that recquires its target to be seen unless the effects creator can somehow see you. Any equipment you are wearning or carrying is also concealed
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.

condition.name: Light
condition.description: Sheds Bright Light for 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet

condition.name: Paralyzed
condition.description:
While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects:
Incapacitated: You have the incapacitated condition
Speed 0: Your speed is 0
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving Throws
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage
Automatic Critical Hits: Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit is the attacker is within 5 feet of you

condition.name: Petrified
condition.description:
While you have the Pertified condition, you experience the following effects:
Turned to Inanimate Substance: You are transformed, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing and carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Your weight increases by a factor of 10, and you cease aging
Incapacited: You have the Incapacitated condition
Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase
Attacks Affected: Attack Roles against you have Advantage
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving Throws
Resist Damage: You have Resistance to all damage
Poison Immunity: You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition

condition.name: Poisoned
condition.description:
While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effects:
Ability Checks and Attacks Affected: You have Disadvantge on attack rolls and ability checks

condition.name: Prone
condition.description:
While you have the Prone condition, your experience the following effects:
Restricted Movement: Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your Speed (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can't right yourself
Attacks Affected: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you have Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage

condition.name: Restrained
condition.description:
While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects:
Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and cannot increase
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage
Saving Throws Affected: You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving Throws

condition.name: Stunned
condition.description:
While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects:
Incapacited: You have the Incapacitated condition
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving Throws
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage

condition.name: Unconscious
condition.description:
While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects.
Inert: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop whatever you’re holding. When this condition ends, you remain Prone.
Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and can’t increase.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Automatic Critical Hits: Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
Unaware: You’re unaware of your surroundings.
